summary: Fixture login shells are reused under the test HOME instead of a per-process TempDir, keeping them inside test cleanup even after SIGKILL or exec. Started members default TMPDIR to /var/tmp when it is absent, empty, or inherited from a Linux tmpfs; an explicit declaration wins.

compatibility.detail: No wire or CLI changes. Existing inherited disk TMPDIR values and explicit seat TMPDIR declarations are preserved. The default applies to newly started members.

downtime.detail: Running seats keep their current environment; no forced restart.

manual.detail: No action required. Previously leaked /tmp directories and old session scratch remain subject to existing host cleanup; this change does not sweep them.

recovery.detail: Revert restores the prior launch environment and fixture placement. No persistent graph state changes.
